newsitem.title: USA: Stocks clobbered as bond market falls.
newsitem.headline: Stocks clobbered as bond market falls.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average suffered a big correction Wednesday as the bond market dropped sharply following disappointing results from the latest Treasury sale.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow fell 139.67 points, or 1.93 percent, to 7,085.65, backing off after having gained 250 points since last Friday on hopes of a federal budget agreement.
In the broader market, declining issues outnumbered advances 2-1 on active volume of 500 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
